commonStyle: Painted graphic-novel military science-fiction concept art matching the existing Frontlines infantry atlases and premium Commander material quality. Believable steel, fabric and practical equipment; stylized but structurally sound anatomy; strong silhouettes, restrained faction accents, atmospheric lighting. Each square panel is a finished independent illustration with an action/event for an Order or equipment/infrastructure for an Asset. Readable at a small card size. Keep the main subject and identifying equipment inside the central 80% with a generous top safe area. No text, letters, numbers, labels, UI, card frames, borders, logos, watermarks, generic glyphs, flat vector art or plastic 3D look. Do not stretch images.

stonewall.identity: Disciplined defensive troops, reinforced steel-blue and charcoal armor, cyan seam lights, layered angular shields, prepared bunker positions and military engineering.
stonewall.layout: Independent 2×2 square illustrated panel batches, each read in row-major order; no visible gutter text or labels. Do not put two runtime subjects in one cell.

cards.name: Forward Aid Station
cards.rulesText: Immobile. Medic — heal each ally here by 1 at your turn start. Holds Presence. Free Action — costs Capacity; no Command Action.
cards.scene: A hardened forward medical shelter built into a bunker recess: armored stretcher bay, compact diagnostic equipment, secured medical supply crates and a cyan examination lamp. The infrastructure is the principal subject; a tiny medic gives scale.

cards.name: Emergency Triage
cards.rulesText: Heal one friendly battlefield card by 4. Free Action — costs Capacity; no Command Action.
cards.scene: A disciplined combat medic kneels beside a wounded but conscious armored ally behind a concrete barricade, applying a compact field stabilizer to damaged chest plating. Clear active treatment, careful hands, no gore.

cards.name: Brace for Impact
cards.rulesText: Response: reduce damage to the defender from this combat by 3. Costs Capacity; no Command Action.
cards.scene: A defensive soldier braces a broad layered shield as incoming rounds strike it with bright sparks. The shield, protected face and force of the impacts dominate; a bunker wall protects the flank.

cards.name: Hold the Line
cards.rulesText: Ready one exhausted friendly unit. Costs 1 Command Action in addition to Capacity.
cards.scene: An exhausted defender rises from a kneeling position behind a reinforced barricade, gripping a rifle again while a nearby officer signals to hold the line. A renewed defensive stance, not a generic standing portrait.

cards.name: Defensive Fire
cards.rulesText: Deal 3 damage to one enemy battlefield card. Costs 1 Command Action in addition to Capacity.
cards.scene: An entrenched gunner fires a controlled burst through a bunker firing slit at an advancing enemy silhouette. A readable muzzle flash and tracer path communicate the action while the concrete emplacement communicates defense.

cards.name: Field Redoubt
cards.rulesText: Immobile. Fortify. Command — other allies here gain +1 Attack. Holds Presence. Costs 1 Command Action in addition to Capacity.
cards.scene: A compact angular field redoubt dominates a ruined avenue: overlapping armored firing ports, reinforced walls, a roof-mounted command antenna and protected cyan-lit observation bay. Fortification equipment, not a soldier portrait.

cards.name: Line Reinforcement
cards.rulesText: Reinforce — heal one friendly permanent by 2, then give it temporary Armor 1 until your next offensive turn starts. Does not stack with printed Armor. Free Action — costs Capacity; no Command Action.
cards.scene: A military engineer fastens a replacement armor plate onto a worn allied shield while the defender holds the position. The installed plate and repaired suit clearly show reinforcement rather than a floating shield icon.

bruiser.identity: Aggressive assault troops, battered charcoal/orange armor, exposed reinforcement, oversized but practical demolition weapons, rushing motion, sparks and impact.
bruiser.layout: Independent 2×2 square illustrated panel batches, each read in row-major order; no visible gutter text or labels. Do not put two runtime subjects in one cell.

cards.name: Assault Standard
cards.rulesText: Immobile. Command — other allies here gain +1 Attack. Holds Presence. Costs 1 Command Action in addition to Capacity.
cards.scene: An oversized battered assault standard mounted in a powered steel brace amid a breached wall. Heavy orange fabric and welded signal lamps identify a rallying military asset; distant assault troops give scale without stealing focus.

cards.name: Demolition Charge
cards.rulesText: Deal 5 damage to one enemy battlefield card. Costs 1 Command Action in addition to Capacity.
cards.scene: A carefully planted directional demolition charge explodes against an armored barrier. Large slabs of concrete and a concentrated orange blast communicate a single prepared demolition strike; no gore.

cards.name: Second Wind
cards.rulesText: Ready one exhausted friendly unit. Costs 1 Command Action in addition to Capacity.
cards.scene: A scarred assault trooper pulls a spent ammunition belt free and hauls themself back to a standing fighting position amid rubble. Tense renewed momentum after exhaustion, with practical heavy weapon equipment.

cards.name: Violent Reprisal
cards.rulesText: Response: deal 2 damage to the attacker before combat. Costs Capacity; no Command Action.
cards.scene: A wounded shock trooper unexpectedly counterfires at an incoming attacker from behind broken cover. A close muzzle burst and fresh sparks on the attacker’s armor show an immediate violent reprisal without gore.

cards.name: Combat Resupply
cards.rulesText: Draw 2 cards. Free Action — costs Capacity; no Command Action.
cards.scene: An assault loader passes a fresh oversized ammunition belt and power canister to a waiting heavy gunner beside an opened combat supply crate. The transfer of usable supplies is unmistakable.

cards.name: Overrun Charge
cards.rulesText: Deal 6 damage to one enemy battlefield card. Costs 1 Command Action in addition to Capacity.
cards.scene: A massive armored assault trooper drives through a crumbling enemy barricade in a devastating frontal push. Heavy weapon discharge, falling debris and forward motion form one clear breakthrough action.

cards.name: Combat Triage Rig
cards.rulesText: Heal one wounded friendly permanent by 3. Free Action — costs Capacity; no Command Action.
cards.scene: A field technician clamps a rugged emergency repair-and-stabilization rig onto a wounded assault soldier’s battered armor behind rubble. Heavy practical hydraulic and medical equipment, orange work lamps, no miraculous glow or gore.

syndicate.identity: Professional private-military specialists, clean charcoal/gold equipment, tactical optics, precise targeting, communications hardware and controlled combined-arms coordination.
syndicate.layout: Independent 2×2 square illustrated panel batches, each read in row-major order; no visible gutter text or labels. Do not put two runtime subjects in one cell.

cards.name: Coordination Relay
cards.rulesText: Immobile. Command — other allies here gain +1 Attack. Holds Presence. Costs 1 Command Action in addition to Capacity.
cards.scene: A portable armored communications relay with clean antenna arrays, gold indicator strips and secured power modules, stationed behind a coordinated squad. The deployable hardware is central and clearly readable.

cards.name: Intelligence Network
cards.rulesText: Draw 2 cards. Free Action — costs Capacity; no Command Action.
cards.scene: A reconnaissance operator receives fresh information from two compact camera drones while comparing physical sensor data on a small tactical slate. Clean professional equipment and an active intelligence-gathering scene; no readable UI text.

cards.name: Supply Interference
cards.rulesText: Tie up up to 4 available enemy Presence as temporary spending until their next offensive turn. Costs 1 Command Action in addition to Capacity.
cards.scene: A professional electronic-warfare specialist interrupts an enemy supply drone’s power-control connection. A grounded crate carrier stops mid-delivery while its status lamps fail; show the disrupted logistics as the action.

cards.name: Override Protocol
cards.rulesText: Counter: cancel the defender’s response Order. Cannot cancel a Guard interception. Costs Capacity; no Command Action.
cards.scene: A specialist uses a compact countermeasure transmitter as a hostile tactical signal dissolves before reaching an allied unit. Physical equipment, tight restrained golden interference arcs and a protected ally communicate a timely override.

cards.name: Contract Strike
cards.rulesText: Deal 3 damage to one enemy battlefield card. Costs 1 Command Action in addition to Capacity.
cards.scene: A clean-equipped marksman delivers one calculated rifle shot through a narrow opening toward a specific armored target. Scope, muzzle flash and precise tracer alignment convey selective removal; no gore.

cards.name: Signal Lock
cards.rulesText: Sabotage — one enemy battlefield card loses all printed traits until its owner’s next offensive turn begins. Costs 1 Command Action in addition to Capacity.
cards.scene: An electronic specialist locks down a hostile armored unit’s communications and powered auxiliary equipment. A compact transmitter in the foreground and darkened enemy optics in the middle ground show functional sabotage, not a glyph.

cards.name: Target Designator
cards.rulesText: Mark one enemy permanent: it takes +1 incoming regular combat damage until its next offensive turn starts. Marks do not stack. Costs 1 Command Action in addition to Capacity.
cards.scene: A tactical observer uses a compact laser designator to illuminate one exposed enemy armored unit across the avenue. Visible optics and a narrow gold beam identify deliberate target preparation; no floating target icon.

cards.name: Field Link
cards.rulesText: Immobile asset. Command — other allies here gain +1 Attack. Medic — at your offensive turn start, heal every ally here by 1. Costs 1 Command Action in addition to Capacity.
cards.scene: A combined communications and field-care station: clean armored relay mast, secured medical tools, power cartridges and a small protected service cradle. Show one functional tactical deployable asset, not a portrait.

cards.name: Cover Protocol
cards.rulesText: Reinforce — heal one friendly permanent by 1, then give it temporary Armor 1 until your next offensive turn starts. Does not stack with printed Armor. Free Action — costs Capacity; no Command Action.
cards.scene: A technician locks a sleek temporary armor module onto a damaged allied combat suit while the soldier takes cover. Professional fastening hardware and a small diagnostic light show a protective repair protocol.

nightwalker.identity: Stealth troops with dark graphite masks and hoods, narrow violet light accents, suppressed weapons, low-light smoke, reconnaissance and disruption technology.
nightwalker.layout: Independent 2×2 square illustrated panel batches, each read in row-major order; no visible gutter text or labels. Do not put two runtime subjects in one cell.

cards.name: Targeting Beacon
cards.rulesText: Immobile. Command — other allies here gain +1 Attack. Holds Presence. Costs 1 Command Action in addition to Capacity.
cards.scene: A low-profile targeting beacon planted on a rooftop ledge: three narrow prongs, a recessed violet sensor lens and compact battery housing amid dark smoke. Its physical deployable silhouette dominates.

cards.name: From the Dark
cards.rulesText: Response: deal 4 damage to the attacker before combat. Costs Capacity; no Command Action.
cards.scene: A masked operative fires from a deep shadowed doorway into the flank of an approaching attacker. A small suppressed muzzle flash, stealthy concealment and clear surprise angle depict the ambush without gore.

cards.name: Surgical Strike
cards.rulesText: Deal 5 damage to one enemy battlefield card. Costs 1 Command Action in addition to Capacity.
cards.scene: A hooded precision operative takes one suppressed shot from a narrow rooftop opening toward a valuable enemy specialist. Weapon and target alignment tell the selective strike; restrained violet rim light and smoke.

cards.name: Fade Away
cards.rulesText: Response: move the defender one legal territory toward home. This attack deals no combat damage. Costs Capacity; no Command Action.
cards.scene: An armored operative steps backward into a smoke-darkened passage just as incoming tracers cross the space they occupied. Show the evasive retreat and missed attack, without implying teleportation or healing.

cards.name: Night Reconnaissance
cards.rulesText: Draw 2 cards. Free Action — costs Capacity; no Command Action.
cards.scene: A concealed rooftop scout guides a tiny low-light reconnaissance drone over the battlefield. Masked scout, sensor optics and the drone’s observation cone are readable; the scene depicts gathering information.

cards.name: Blackout Protocol
cards.rulesText: Sabotage — one enemy battlefield card loses all printed traits until its owner’s next offensive turn begins. Costs 1 Command Action in addition to Capacity.
cards.scene: A saboteur connects a compact disruption device to an enemy armored equipment junction while the unit’s illuminated optics and auxiliary modules go dark. Covert physical interference, dark violet lighting, no glyph substitute.

cards.name: Ghost Extraction
cards.rulesText: Return a friendly battlefield card to hand. Its committed Presence is freed; its wounds remain. Redeployment pays its printed Capacity and Command Action cost. Free Action — costs Capacity; no Command Action.
cards.scene: A wounded masked operative is pulled out of a threatened position on a discreet extraction line toward a dark rooftop. Damaged armor remains visible, and the action clearly depicts withdrawal for later redeployment rather than instant healing.

cards.name: Exposure Window
cards.rulesText: Mark one enemy permanent: it takes +1 incoming regular combat damage until its next offensive turn starts. Marks do not stack. Costs 1 Command Action in addition to Capacity.
cards.scene: A hidden scout opens a narrow shutter in the smoke and directs an infrared designator onto a briefly revealed enemy specialist. A physical optic and a vulnerable illuminated target show the opening.

cards.name: False Route
cards.rulesText: Add 3 temporary Presence spending to the opponent until their next offensive turn starts. Does not reduce Command Actions. Costs 1 Command Action in addition to Capacity.
cards.scene: A covert operative sets a decoy sensor projector at a forked ruined alley, luring an enemy supply patrol toward the wrong route. A false moving silhouette and the real shadowed escape path convey calculated misdirection; no text signs.

rogue.layout: Independent 2×2 square illustrated panel batches, each read in row-major order; no visible gutter text or labels. Do not put two runtime subjects in one cell.

cards.scene: A patched portable field workshop fills the scene: mismatched welded bench, reclaimed power cells, practical hand tools and a partially repaired armored component. A small mechanic in the background supplies scale.

cards.scene: A resourceful field soldier helps a wounded ally back behind a scrap-built rear barricade, carrying their damaged weapon and kit. Visible wounds in armor remain; this is a costly tactical withdrawal, not rejuvenation.

cards.name: Keep Moving

cards.scene: A fatigued scavenger soldier refastens a loose armor strap, collects their modified rifle and rises to move again. An improvised practical adjustment restores readiness amid a rough battlefield.

cards.name: Break Contact
cards.rulesText: Response: move the defender one legal territory toward home. This attack deals no combat damage. Costs Capacity; no Command Action.
cards.scene: A patched-armored skirmisher breaks contact through a jagged side alley while incoming rounds strike discarded scrap cover behind them. Readable retreat direction and evasive movement, without teleportation.

cards.name: Hit and Run

cards.scene: A scavenged-gear raider fires a short burst while already moving toward a side exit. A modified rifle, one struck enemy armor plate and a clear escape route show opportunistic hit-and-run tactics; no gore.

cards.name: Field Options
cards.rulesText: Adapt — choose one: Repair (heal one ally by 3); Resupply (draw 2); Reposition (ready one exhausted ally). Every mode costs 1 Command Action. Costs 1 Command Action in addition to Capacity.
cards.scene: An adaptable field operative at a scrap-built supply post chooses between a repair tool, a fresh ammunition bundle and an open flanking route. All three practical options are integrated into one active scene, not separate icons or panels.

cards.name: Salvage Cache
cards.rulesText: Immobile asset. Medic — at your offensive turn start, heal every ally here by 1. Scavenge — draw 1 when another ally here is destroyed, once per player per turn. Free Action — costs Capacity; no Command Action.
cards.scene: A secured salvage cache behind cover: mismatched storage bins holding reclaimed armor plates, repaired medical tools and scavenged power cells. The stationary supply infrastructure is the hero subject; salvaged wreckage nearby explains its source.
